title: Align dispatch dependency resolution with committed plan model for self-produced consumes
required_tests: src/__tests__/pair-f2-artifact-handoff.test.ts#consume ∩ own-produce with no predecessor → self-shadowed, no handoff
src/__tests__/pair-f2-artifact-handoff.test.ts#consume ∩ own-produce + real depends_on producer → producer still binds
src/__tests__/pair-f2-artifact-handoff.test.ts#self-produced consume skipped but a genuinely unbound consume still fails
description: BASE a1b8da8. Fixes the validator/dispatcher inconsistency behind PLAN_DATAFLOW_UNBOUND aborts (live repro: mission MSN_01M54A6V T2 declared consumes=produces=exports/journal-export.json, depends_on=[] → plan COMMITTED because plan-dataflow requiredEdges exempts consume ∩ own-produce from needing an in-plan producer edge, then dispatch resolveForConsumer demanded a predecessor producer anyway → unbound_consume → FAIL_CLOSED_DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION → REPLAN → ABORT). Fix: in resolveForConsumer, when a consume has no depends_on predecessor producer and no canonical external-source stamp, a consume name the task itself declares in produces (exact normalized-name match, same semantics requiredEdges uses) is skipped — the task creates the artifact itself. Ordering preserved: real depends_on predecessors still bind first, external PAIR-stamped sources still re-prove before the skip, genuinely unbound consumes still fail closed, delivery/manifest tasks untouched (early return). No planner, plan-commit, digest, or authority change. Tests: A8 self-consume no producer → zero entries (failing-first verified on BASE: DEP:FAIL_CLOSED_DEPENDENCY_RESOLUTION); A9 self-consume + real predecessor → still binds producer entry; A10 self-consume skipped while a second unbound consume still fails closed.
